name: ontopoc
description: OntoPoc is the confirmation gate between a team's data and the AI that answers questions about it: agents answer only from definitions a named person confirmed against the current data, otherwise they refuse and say who can confirm. This plugin's two commands (/ontopoc-build, /ontopoc-review) still work on the earlier run-based screen (legacy.html: build an ontology from tables or a document, review it item by item), not on the team app's gate. The plugin is only an entry point: start the local OntoPoc service first.
